AMBIGUOUS_ROLE.raw: *Extreme-right candidate [[Jean-Marie Le Pen]] qualifies for second round of [[French presidential election, 2002|French Presidential Elections]]. Right-wing incumbent [[Jacques Chirac]] places first. Socialist prime minister [[Lionel Jospin]] places third and announces his retirement from politics. Thousands take to the street all over France to protest against Le Pen.

AMBIGUOUS_ROLE.raw: * A new [[Bundestag]] (German parliament) is chosen. In a very tight election, [[Gerhard Schröder]] defeats [[Edmund Stoiber]] to remain [[Chancellor of Germany (Federal Republic)|Chancellor]]. The [[German Green Party]] does very well. The coalition between the [[Social Democratic Party of Germany|SPD]] and the [[German Green Party]] continue with [[Joschka Fischer]] as vice chancellor.

INLINE_TEMPLATE.raw: *A tanker, the ''Amazonian Explorer'', arrived in [[Puerto la Cruz]], [[Venezuela]], 200 kilometers east of [[Caracas]], the capital.  President [[Hugo Chávez]] traveled to the port to supervise the unloading of {{convert|525000|oilbbl|m3}} of gasoline.
